dress_code.men: Any decent traditional outfit for Darshan. For Garbhagriha Abhishekam, men must remove Shirt and Vest (Dhoti / Pancha required).
dress_code.women: Any decent traditional outfit for Darshan. For Garbhagriha Abhishekam, women must wear Saree or Chudidhar with Dupatta.

dos: Do take a holy bath in the Triveni Sangam (Godavari, Pranahita, Saraswati river confluence) before entering the temple queue lines.
Do offer prayers to Lord Kaleshwara (Yama) FIRST, before worshipping Lord Mukteshwara (Shiva) as per ancient temple tradition.
Do maintain quiet and follow line discipline during peak rush hours.
Do deposit footwear, leather items, and electronic gadgets at designated cloakrooms outside.
Do wear traditional attire and place tilak/kumkum on your forehead as a mark of devotion.
donts: Don't wear any footwear inside or around the main temple boundary walls.
Don't take photographs or record videos inside the sanctum sanctorum (Garbhagriha); cameras and cell phones are strictly prohibited.
Don't consume non-vegetarian food, alcohol, or tobacco products before or during your temple visit.
Don't carry plastic bags, matchboxes, or sharp objects inside security check zones.
Don't deal with unauthorized brokers or touts promising quick darshan.
Don't litter or throw trash along the Triveni Sangam river ghats or temple premises.
electronic_ban: Don't take photographs or record videos inside the sanctum sanctorum (Garbhagriha); cameras and cell phones are strictly prohibited. Deposit electronic gadgets at designated cloakrooms outside.
safety_guidelines: Take care while bathing in Triveni Sangam. Use safety railings. Do not enter deep zones or cross security barricades.
